files.purpose: Defines the whole left sidebar of the main window: the "Search threads" field with the bell-shaped activity-view toggle, the scrolling thread list in two layouts (grouped under projects, or an activity layout with "Needs attention", "Pinned", day groups and a foldable "Settled" section), and the fixed "Add project" and "Settings" rows at the bottom. The same view also runs inside the chat's Threads popover when `inPopover` is true; there it drops the traffic-light clearance and the window-drag background, and picking a thread calls `dismiss`. The file also owns the row types (project, thread, helper, Hydra head cards, folded helper stub), the rename/delete/archive popovers anchored on rows (only thread rows, via threadRow at 875, carry all three: `archivePopover(for: thread, on: renamePopover(for: thread, on: deletePopover(...)))`; helper rows at 348 carry only `archivePopover(for: thread, on: deletePopover(for: thread, on: SidebarHelperRow(...)))` with no rename popover, and HeadCardsRow (369-372) and HelperStubRow carry none), live drag-to-reorder with haptics and cursor changes, settle/reopen and archive ghost animations, the row context menus and ellipsis actions, and several caches that keep re-rendering cheap (PlacementCache, SidebarItemCache, FrameHolder, RowHeights, RowFrames). It also declares the app-wide `MinuteClock` (internal, not private), whose 60 s tick drives the relative time labels.

Head cards: card fill Chrome.overlay(0.04), rounded Chrome.rowCornerRadius, padding 6, rows spacing 6; glyphs HydraGlyph size 14; each glyph is a Button selecting the head and has its own context menu `ThreadActions.makeContextMenu(model:thread:settleFirst: false, requests:)` (1495-1505), but HeadCardsRow is wrapped in no rename, delete or archive popover (369-372), so the glyph's "Rename" and (with confirmBeforeDeleting on) "Delete…" show nothing; selected glyph background Circle Chrome.overlay(0.14) padding -3; hover scale 1.18; tooltip "<persona name> · <task>"; accessibility "<persona name>, <task>"; at most 12 visible until expanded; chevron.down/chevron.up (.caption2 semibold) 14x14 toggle with tooltip "Show all N heads"/"Show fewer heads", snappy 0.18; card height animates snappy 0.18

Archive popover: width 272; content VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 9) (917); text "Archive “<title>”?" with title semibold, .callout, up to 2 lines, tail truncation, `.frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)` (923); buttons right-aligned HStack spacing 6: "Delete" in red, .glass, tooltip "Remove the thread and its history"; "Archive" .glassProminent, default action, focused on appear, tooltip "Move it to Archived (Return)"; controlSize small; padding horizontal 8, top 6, bottom 4

Delete popover: width 280; section header "Delete this thread?"; note "“<title>” and its history will be removed. Files in your project stay as they are."; divider; destructive item "Delete thread" (trash); when the thread has a worktree also "Delete thread and worktree" (trash)

Rename popover: width 300, padding 14, VStack spacing 10; "Rename thread" (.body semibold); TextField placeholder "Title" rounded border focused on appear; "Cancel" (.bordered) and "Rename" (.borderedProminent, default action, disabled when text is blank after trimming spaces); controlSize regular; presented with .presentedChrome()

Thread actions (ellipsis and context menu): "Rename" (pencil); "Pin"/"Unpin" (pin / pin.slash) only for open non-helper threads; "Forward to new thread" (arrowshape.turn.up.right); "Reveal worktree in Finder" (folder) when a worktree exists; helper: "Archive" only; others: "Settle"/"Reopen" (checkmark.circle / arrow.uturn.backward) and "Archive" (archivebox) ordered settle-first when threadFinishAction == .settle, the first of the two starting a group; "Delete…" (trash, destructive)
Row insertion/removal transition: insertion opacity easeIn 0.18 s after 0.12 s delay, removal opacity easeOut 0.06 s; settled rows, the Settled header and gaps use plain .opacity
Reorder animations: neighbour slide spring(response 0.28, dampingFraction 0.82); release spring(response 0.32, dampingFraction 0.8); settle pop spring(response 0.3, dampingFraction 0.45)

ThreadGhostBadge (2084-2110), the badge drawn into glide ghosts, differs from ThreadBadge (2144-2176): running shows `MiniSpinner(cellSize: 2.4, isStill: true)` with no `.help` tooltip, it has no unread-dot overlay, and it takes needsInput/isRunning from a runtime snapshot at launch (`isRunning = runtime?.isRunning == true || runtime?.isHydraMerging == true || runtime?.hasWorkingHelpers == true`); otherwise the same order: hand.raised.fill Chrome.orange, spinner, pin.fill scale 0.9 Chrome.danger.opacity(0.85), ProviderIcon size 14
feature_notes: Search: query is the field text trimmed of whitespace and newlines. Matching lowercases the query; a project whose name contains it returns all its threads (each followed by its helpers), otherwise threads (and helpers) whose lowercased title contains it. count in each result is the project's total of threads plus helpers. Return selects the first thread of the first result; onSubmit (86-90) has NO `query.isEmpty` guard and calls `searchResults(helpers:)` with whatever the query is, whereas moveSearchSelection starts with `guard !query.isEmpty else { return }` (720). With an empty field the needle is "" and the outcome depends on Swift `String.contains("")` semantics (see unresolved_questions). Up/Down move the selection within the flattened results, clamped at the ends; with no current selection in the results, Up picks the last, Down the first. Drag-to-reorder is disabled while searching.

Project layout order: projects in model.projects order with a Chrome.groupGap gap before every project but the first. A project row's count is threads + all their helpers. Expanded projects list open threads with pinned first, then the settled threads; before the first settled one a 4 pt gap (only if an open thread preceded) and a Settled header (isFirst false). When settledCollapsed the settled threads are not listed; settledCollapsed is one global flag shared by all projects and the activity layout (see persisted_fields).

Activity layout: shows threads not archived and not in a panel; helpers whose parent is also shown sit under the parent, others stand alone. Order: "Needs attention" (runtime has approvals or questions, not settled) first with isFirst true; then "Pinned" open threads; then day groups by updatedAt descending with titles "Today", "Yesterday", the wide weekday within 7 days, "month day" within the year, else "month day year"; then "Settled" sorted by AppModel.settledFirst, rows only when not collapsed, with no peers (no dragging among them).

placed(): a thread's activityOrder counts only when activityOrderDay is the same day as updatedAt. Two placed threads sort by ascending order; an unplaced thread sorts above a placed one; otherwise newest updatedAt first.

Activity style: when activityThreadStyle == .icon the project name is not shown and the front slot shows the project icon or .symbol("folder.fill"); in the name style the project name is shown (`projectName: compact ? nil : (project?.name ?? "")`, 598 and 616: when the project is missing the empty string is still non-nil, so an open row is laid out detailed, `isDetailed = projectName != nil && !isSettled`, with vertical padding 7 and a project line of the folder/branch icon and an empty text, or the merge stage) and a picked icon (if any) leads the title and replaces the project line.

Item ids: project rows "project-<uuid>", gaps "gap-<uuid>" and "settled-gap-<uuid>", settled headers "settled-header-<uuid>" (project layout) or "settled" (activity), headers "attention", "day-Pinned", "day-<title>"; thread rows use sidebarItemID ("settled-<uuid>" when settled, else the uuid) in the project layout and for settled activity rows, but open activity rows use thread.id.uuidString directly; helpers use their uuid, head cards "heads-<uuid>", helper stubs "helpers-<uuid>".

Helpers: grouped from threads that are not archived and either not in a panel or a Hydra head, keyed by parentThreadID, newest createdAt first. A settled parent shows no helpers. A parent with foldsHelpers shows one stub row. Otherwise non-head helpers each get a row (the last ends the connector unless head cards follow), and heads get one card row if any exist and not (hydraAutoHidesIdleHeads and none running). Heads are ordered running first, then newest createdAt.

Head card layout: perRow = 7 until measured, else max(1, Int((usable + 22 - 14) / 22)) with usable = width - 28 - 2*6 - 3; gaps stretch to max(8, (usable - perRow*14)/(perRow-1)) only when `perRow > 1 && width > 0` (1459-1461), otherwise tightGap = 22 - 14 = 8; visible heads capped at 12 behind a chevron row that counts as one extra card row. Source comment: seven glyphs (7 x 14 + 6 x 8 = 146) plus the 3 pt badge fit the 170 pt the card has at the sidebar's 210 pt minimum.

Reorder: one list-wide DragGesture(minimumDistance 4) in the "sidebar-list" space. The grabbed id is the open, unsettled row whose recorded frame contains the start location (settled and helper rows record no frame). Peers are the activity group (activity layout) or the project's unsettled threads. Slot height per peer = (measured row height or Chrome.rowHeight) + 1, plus each helper row (or the folded stub, fallback 24) + 1, plus the head card (fallback headCardHeight(rows: (headCount+5)/6), i.e. 6 glyphs per row over ALL heads, 847-848) + 1 when heads show; this fallback disagrees with the card itself, which lays out 7 per row until measured (1453), caps visible heads at 12 and adds one chevron row (1443-1444, 1463), so a port that derives the fallback from the card layout diverges from upstream; RowDrag.settle uses fallbackHeight Chrome.rowHeight + 1. Each swap calls moveInActivity(among: group) or moveThread inside the 0.28/0.82 spring, refreshes peers and plays an .alignment haptic. Helpers and head cards ride with the dragged parent (same offset, zIndex 1).
Scroll freeze: while the list scrolls, hit testing is off; the flag clears on scroll phase .idle or 150 ms after the last content-offset change.

Delete flow: context-menu and ellipsis Delete go through confirmBeforeDeleting: when on, they only set `pendingDeletionID = thread.id` (189-194, 890-895, 359-364), and the popover opens only on rows wrapped with deletePopover (thread rows at 875, helper rows at 348); a head-card glyph's context-menu "Delete…" (1495-1505) sets pendingDeletionID and nothing is shown or deleted; when off, model.delete(id) runs immediately. A confirmed delete is stored and executed in a later main-actor Task only once the popover content has disappeared (fix for a crash described in the comment when the row anchoring the popover was removed). Clicking away or Escape confirms nothing. "Delete thread and worktree" passes removeWorktree true.

Archive shortcut flow: model.archiveRequest opens the archive popover on that thread's row, if one wrapped in archivePopover is realized (the list is not scrolled to it); a request for an unknown thread returns before `model.archiveRequest = nil` and stays uncleared (200-201). In it, Return or keypad Enter (key codes 36, 76) archives and Escape (53) dismisses, also when the keys land on a ThreadWindow behind the popover, provided no modifier in KeyChord.allowedModifiers is held. Delete from that popover goes through confirmDeletion with removeWorktree false, with no further confirmation.

Rename: from the ellipsis via onRename (reads the live record at click time: `let live = model.thread(thread.id) ?? thread`, 884-888 and 353-357) or from the context menu via menuRequests.rename (2261-2263: `requests.rename = thread` with the thread value captured when the menu was built, so `renameText = thread.title` at 186 can prefill a stale title); the rename popover is attached only to thread rows (875): SidebarHelperRow (348) has no renamePopover, so renaming a helper from its ellipsis or context menu in the main list sets `renaming` and presents nothing (it would only appear if that helper is drawn as a threadRow, e.g. in search at 711 or as a standalone activity row), and a head glyph's context-menu Rename likewise shows nothing; the popover's Rename button is disabled for blank text but pressing Return in the field calls onRename(text) without that check.

Settle: only when threadFinishAction == .settle does a check appear on hover; click plays SettleChime when settings.settleSound, pops the check (spring 0.3/0.45) and calls model.settle(id, sounds: false) inside Chrome.panelSlide; settle() is guarded `guard !isSettling, !thread.isSettled else { return }` (1916) and `@State isSettling` (1714) is set true (1918) and never set back to false anywhere in the file: the popped check goes away only because the settled thread gets a new item id `"settled-<uuid>"` (sidebarItemID, 1060-1062) and so a fresh row, so a port that reuses the row across settle keeps the popped check; the row leaves with the removal fade, no ghost. Reopen flies a ghost (RowGlideAnimator, direction .reopen) from the row to the new open row or, if out of view, to the list's top edge (fallback CGRect x: from.minX, y: bounds.minY - arrivalHeight, width: from.width, height: arrivalHeight, where `arrivalHeight = settled ? ThreadRowMetrics.settledHeight : (projectName != nil ? ThreadRowMetrics.detailedHeight : Chrome.rowHeight)`, so 48 for a reopen in the activity name style; departure face uses trailingClearance with `showsActions: true`, arrival with `showsActions: false`; departureFill `Self.fill(isSelected:, isHovering: isHovering)`, arrivalFill `Self.fill(isSelected:, isHovering: false)`, 1948-1977), then calls model.reopenAnimated. The settle ghost branch remains in glide() but the source comment says it no longer runs. Menu, shortcut and palette settle/reopen arrive as model.finishRequest, taken by the matching row only when request.reopens equals the row's settled state.

Archive button (when finish action is not settle): GenieAnimator launches a ghost of the row face (trailing clearance 52, fill overlay 0.12 selected / 0.06) from the row's window frame, then model.archive inside Chrome.panelSlide.
Merge stage text: while runtime.isHydraMerging, hydraMergeStage or "Merging" followed by U+2026; it replaces the project name in the project line and is the spinner tooltip.
Project activation: row dims to 0.55 when inactive; the toggle item flips it, and "Follow global setting" clears the per-project override.
Popover mode: onChange of selectedThreadID calls dismiss; rows get listFrame nil so reopen does not fly a ghost (glide returns early).
Reveal: when model.sidebarRevealThreadID is set, it is cleared and the list scrolls that thread's item to centre with Chrome.panelSlide.
Search row keys use sidebarItemID so a thread settled from search changes rows; ProjectRow in search does not toggle expansion.
MinuteClock ticks every 60 s; RelativeTimeLabel reads only it, so time labels alone re-render.

Equatable rows: SidebarThreadRow compares snapshot id, title, updatedAt, isPinned, isSettled, projectName, isDragged and whether onToggleFold is set; SidebarHelperRow compares id, title, updatedAt, isPinned, isSettled and isLast. Line 1412 holds a stray doc comment ("The ellipsis popover's items...") that sits above static func == rather than makeActions.

B1->B2: 24 lines replaced (git numstat 24 insertions, 24 deletions; 177-line diff output), line count unchanged at 2696; no label, ordering or layout-constant change. Changes are typography, one helper swap, one isolation annotation and one capture change. (1) query uses the new shared String.trimmed helper (same whitespacesAndNewlines trim) instead of trimmingCharacters inline. (2) listSpace became `private nonisolated static let`. (3) Fixed font sizes became macOS text styles (upstream commit e6ec1f44d 'feat(appearance): dedicated Appearance pane, app-wide zoom...'): search empty title size 13 semibold -> .body semibold; empty hint 11 -> .subheadline; archive question 12 -> .callout; rename title 13 semibold -> .body semibold; project count 11 -> .subheadline monospacedDigit; helper title 12 -> .callout; head-card chevron 9 semibold -> .caption2 semibold; helper stub label 11 -> .subheadline; project-line icon 10 -> .footnote and text 12 -> .callout; ActivityHeader 12 semibold -> .callout semibold; Settled chevron 9 -> .caption2, 'Settled' 12 -> .callout semibold, count 12 -> .callout; ActivityStatus hand 11 -> .subheadline; RelativeTimeLabel 11 -> .subheadline monospacedDigit. Unchanged fixed sizes: thread title 12/13 in ThreadRowFace and the stub chevron size 8 bold. (4) ProjectPairMenuItems buttons no longer capture the model weakly ([weak model] / model?.) but call model.setHydraPair directly, and the doc comment now says the value view holds the model so there is no cycle.

Remove project: "Remove project" (trash, destructive) calls `model.removeProject(project)` immediately from both the ellipsis actions (1213-1215) and the context menu (1184-1187, behind `[weak model, project]`); this file shows no confirmation for it, unlike thread delete.
unresolved_questions: UNRESOLVED: exact point sizes of .body, .callout, .subheadline, .footnote and .caption2 on the reference macOS build and how the new app-wide zoom (AppSettings.appZoom, default 100, per AppSettings.swift:718) scales them; must be measured on a matching 1.6.2 runtime. Note the B1 size 9 chevrons became .caption2, whose macOS size may differ from 9.

Values of Chrome tokens used here (trafficLightDiameter, trafficLightTop, listInset, groupGap, rowHeight, rowCornerRadius, rowHorizontalPadding, iconSize, iconFont, inlineIconFont, panelSlide, hover, colours) are defined in another file and are not established by this file.
Behaviour of RowDrag.settle, RowGlideAnimator, GenieAnimator, SidebarRow, SidebarSearchField, PopoverMenu family and .presentedChrome() lives in other files.

Windows mapping needed for the .glass/.glassProminent button styles, NSHapticFeedbackManager .alignment (no direct Windows equivalent on most hardware), the closed-hand cursor, popover arrow edges and the macOS key codes 36/76/53.
AppModel.settledFirst ordering and model.threads(in:) ordering (sortOrder) are defined elsewhere; this file relies on them for Settled order and the project layout's open-thread order.

Empty-query Return: onSubmit (86-90) runs searchResults with needle "" when the field is empty; whether `project.name.lowercased().contains("")` / `title.contains("")` is true (selects the first thread of the first project) or false (no-op) depends on which Swift String.contains overload resolves; must be checked on the 1.6.2 build before the port picks a behaviour.
